q: “‘My return fare was £171. 6s. 0d. and I enclose the counterfoil. I have no record of other expenses; the major items were chilled liquid sedatives on the flight home at 55 cents a shot. Although taken prn, the last dose I remember is the fourth.”
1988, E[dward] J[ames] Moran Campbell, Not Always on the Level, [London]: British Medical Journal, →ISBN, page 182:
